label: report-verification
argv:
import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
repo=root.parents[3]
report=repo/"docs/superpowers/evidence/2026-09-12-sec-integration/sqlite-candidate.md"
body=report.read_text(encoding="ascii")
receipt=json.loads((root/"logs/evidence-audit.stdout").read_text())
assert receipt["result"]=="pass"
assert receipt["receipt_count"]==28
for entry in receipt["fingerprints"].values():
    assert entry["sha256"] in body, "missing artifact fingerprint"
for step in receipt["steps"]:
    assert "--label "+step["label"] in body, "missing recorded command"
links=[]
for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)",body):
    if target.startswith("https://"):
        continue
    path=(report.parent/target).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(repo) and path.is_file(), target
    links.append(target)
assert hashlib.sha256((root/"logs/evidence-audit.stdout").read_bytes()).hexdigest() in body
print(json.dumps({"report":str(report),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(report.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"artifact_hashes_verified":len(receipt["fingerprints"]),"command_labels_verified":28,"local_links_verified":len(links),"result":"pass"},indent=2))
